methods.label: Follow the repeating cycle
methods.explanation:
Follow the rule until a position repeats. Starting from point \(5\), the bug moves as follows:
\[
5\longrightarrow1\longrightarrow2\longrightarrow4\longrightarrow1.
\]
In particular, the two-point jump from \(4\) passes \(5\) and lands on \(1\). Since the next move depends only on the current point, every return to \(1\) starts the same cycle again. Thus the landing points, beginning with jump \(1\), repeat in blocks \(1,2,4\).

Because \(1995=3\cdot665\), the bug completes exactly \(665\) such blocks. Each block ends at point \(4\), so the answer is \(\boxed{4}\), choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
